name: EFZ Core Tutorial
author: EfzExtendedPractice
description: The 53-lesson core course: fundamentals, offense and meters, defense, system interactions, and battle strategy.

categories.label: FUNDAMENTALS
categories.description: Controls, screen, movement, attacks, and basic defense.

categories.label: OFFENSE & METERS
categories.description: Cancel routes, Special/Super inputs, combo rules, SP/RF, IC, FIC, and juggle time.

categories.label: DEFENSE
categories.description: Guard Gauge, RG/RC, and air-recovery choices.

categories.label: SYSTEM INTERACTIONS
categories.description: Armor, Guard Attacks, special knockdown, wakeup, counters.

categories.label: BATTLE STRATEGY
categories.description: Applying the universal mechanics to match decisions.

scenarios.name: Controls & Direction Notation
scenarios.description: Learn EFZ's four buttons and the direction shorthand used in guides.

scenarios.name: Reading Move and Combo Notation
scenarios.description: Read the shorthand used by guides, Trials, and combo lists.

scenarios.name: Reading the Screen
scenarios.description: Find Life, RF, SP, combo Power, and the juggle gauge.

scenarios.name: Walking and Crouching
scenarios.description: Control distance without committing to a dash.

scenarios.name: Jumps
scenarios.description: Jump straight up, toward, and away.

scenarios.name: Double Jumps
scenarios.description: Change direction once more while airborne.

scenarios.name: Ground Dash, Backdash, and Dash Momentum
scenarios.description: Cover ground quickly and learn when a dash commits you.

scenarios.name: Hover Dash (Misuzu)
scenarios.description: Turn a ground dash into an airborne approach.

scenarios.name: Air Dash
scenarios.description: Air dash forward and backward at useful heights.

scenarios.name: Normal Attacks
scenarios.description: Compare standing and crouching Light, Medium, and Strong attacks.

scenarios.name: Standing, Crouching, and Air Guard
scenarios.description: Guard an overhead, a low, and an air-blockable attack.

scenarios.name: Ground Throws
scenarios.description: Throw a guarding opponent and learn when a throw can connect.

scenarios.name: Air Throw
scenarios.description: Catch an airborne opponent with {input:6C}.

scenarios.name: Air Recovery: When Not to Recover
scenarios.description: Recover in the air - and learn why doing it near the opponent is risky.

scenarios.name: Cancels and Normal Routes
scenarios.description: Build Nayuki's normal route, then finish a dash normal with a Special.

scenarios.name: Jump and Air-Movement Cancels
scenarios.description: Cancel a connected attack into a jump, then continue in the air.

scenarios.name: Special Inputs, Part 1 (Shiori)
scenarios.description: Perform every basic Special motion.

scenarios.name: Special Inputs, Part 2 (Sayuri)
scenarios.description: Learn the Special motions Shiori doesn't have.

scenarios.name: The S Button (Shiori)
scenarios.description: Use Shiori's character-specific S shield.

scenarios.name: SP Gauge and Supers
scenarios.description: Build one SP level and spend it on a Level 1 Super.

scenarios.name: Super Inputs, Part 1 (Shiori)
scenarios.description: Perform Shiori's three Super motions.

scenarios.name: Super Inputs, Part 2 (Sayuri)
scenarios.description: Learn the Super motions Shiori doesn't have.

scenarios.name: The RF Gauge
scenarios.description: Reach Red RF, then see why blocking builds it faster.

scenarios.name: Instant Charge (Red IC)
scenarios.description: IC Nayuki's {input:5C}, then catch its pushback with sliding {input:2C}.

scenarios.name: Power, Guts, and Damage Scaling
scenarios.description: See why later combo hits deal less - and why low-life opponents take less damage.

scenarios.name: Juggle Gauge and Combo Time
scenarios.description: Read how long an air combo can continue.

scenarios.name: Blue IC
scenarios.description: Use Blue IC to extend a combo with restored Power.

scenarios.name: RF Attacks and BIC Safety
scenarios.description: Use an RF version, see its fallback, then make a risky one safe.

scenarios.name: Flicker Instant Charge (FIC)
scenarios.description: Cancel a projectile move during its brief built-in FIC window.

scenarios.name: Final Memory
scenarios.description: Use a character's last-resort Super.

scenarios.name: Guard Gauge
scenarios.description: Build Guard Gauge, then see how it changes the next juggle.

scenarios.name: Recoil Guard
scenarios.description: Tap guard just before impact to avoid the usual time stuck after guarding.

scenarios.name: Choosing a Response after RG
scenarios.description: RG a committed attack, then choose whether to challenge or block.

scenarios.name: Recoil Counter and RG Battles
scenarios.description: When your attack is RG'd, RG the defender's counterattack.

scenarios.name: Air-Recovery Decisions
scenarios.description: Do not recover near the opponent; recover when space is safe.

scenarios.name: Punishing Air Recovery
scenarios.description: Punish an opponent's air recovery with {input:j.6C}.

scenarios.name: Recoil Armor (Mizuka vs Rumi)
scenarios.description: Recognize armor, then practice three answers to it.

scenarios.name: Guard Attacks
scenarios.description: Use an attack that briefly blocks, then beat one with a low.

scenarios.name: Special Knockdown and OTG
scenarios.description: Cancel Mai's throw with Red IC, then hit the grounded opponent with 2C.

scenarios.name: Wakeup Vulnerability
scenarios.description: Find the first moment an opponent can be hit after wakeup.

scenarios.name: Character Counters and IC Exceptions
scenarios.description: Learn why counter moves stop cancels - and when IC can still help.

scenarios.name: Control a Useful Range
scenarios.description: Make a long-reaching attack miss, then hit its recovery.

scenarios.name: Take Space Safely
scenarios.description: Choose walking, dashing, or jumping for the situation.

scenarios.name: Stop a Jump-In
scenarios.description: Stop an opponent's jumping attack.

scenarios.name: Confirm Hit or Block
scenarios.description: Continue on hit; stop before the unsafe follow-up on block.

scenarios.name: Choose a Stable Combo
scenarios.description: Finish reliably when Power, height, or distance changes.

scenarios.name: End with Advantage
scenarios.description: Choose the combo ender that gives the result you want.

scenarios.name: Open a Guard
scenarios.description: Use low, overhead, and delayed throw against the right defense.

scenarios.name: Run Wakeup Offense
scenarios.description: Score a knockdown, cover wakeup, throw a blocker, then safely wait out an invincible attack.

scenarios.name: Survive Pressure
scenarios.description: Block the string with no gap, then escape the version that leaves one.

scenarios.name: Choose When to Recoil Guard
scenarios.description: RG committed attacks; block when RG would add risk.

scenarios.name: Attack into Recoil Guard
scenarios.description: Choose a fast follow-up, Recoil Counter, or disciplined block.

scenarios.name: Spend RF with a Purpose
scenarios.description: Spend Red RF now, or wait for Light Blue RF when it gives more value.
